docs.file_summary: `lock.go` defines `BundleEntry`, `Lockfile`, `ReadLockfile` and `WriteLockfile`. It is imported by 5 files (2 of them tests). Of the others, 3 are in `internal/cli`.

content.text:
ANSWER: `ReadLockfile` is defined in `pkg/lock/lock.go`. Three CLI command implementation files call it and would be affected by an on-disk format change to `okf.lock`:

- `internal/cli/pull.go` — `cmdPull` (call at line 160)
- `internal/cli/restore.go` — `runRestore` (call at line 64)
- `internal/cli/vendor.go` — `cmdVendor` (call at line 37)

(Two test files also call it — `internal/cli/restore_test.go` and `pkg/lock/lock_test.go` — but those aren't CLI command implementations.)

CONFIDENCE: high
